query: Female patient, 57: among female patients aged 52–62 with ischemic versus hemorrhagic stroke, report in‑hospital mortality (%), median LOS (<8 vs ≥8 days) and CKD/diabetes prevalence by comorbidity tertile
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.los < 8 THEN 1 END) AS short_los_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.los >= 8 THEN 1 END) AS long_los_count, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.code = 'CKD' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS ckd_prevalence, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.code = 'DIAB' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS diabetes_prevalence, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.code = 'ASA' THEN 1 END) AS asa_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.code = 'ARF' THEN 1 END) AS arf_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.code = 'ARM' THEN 1 END) AS arm_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.code = 'ASA' OR s.code = 'ARF' OR s.code = 'ARM' THEN 1 END) AS asa_arf_arm_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.code = 'CKD' OR d.code = 'DIAB' THEN 1 END) AS ckd_diabetes_count FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN services s ON p.subject_id = s.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 57 AND a.admission_type_id IN (10, 11) AND d.icd_code IN ('I10', 'I11', 'I12', 'I13', 'I14', 'I15', 'I20', 'I21', 'I22', 'I23', 'I24', 'I25', 'I30', 'I31', 'I32', 'I33', 'I34', 'I35', 'I40', 'I41', 'I42', 'I43', 'I44', 'I45', 'I50', 'I51', 'I52', 'I53', 'I54', 'I55', 'I60', 'I61', 'I62', 'I63', 'I64', 'I65');
